newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 29.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Tuesday:
* Congressional Republicans and the Clinton administration agreed on how to balance the budget for the first time in nearly three decades.

* The top general of the Air Force asked to retire early, in part because he believes one or more Air Force officers will unfairly be held responsible for the terrorist attack in Saudi Arabia that killed 19 airmen last year.
* Baptist leaders are questioning the finances of the National Baptist Convention U.S.A. Inc amid concern that the group has squandered its money and potential.
* Hideki Irabu, the highest paid and most-hyped rookie in Yankee history, was demoted to the minor leagues for at least 10 days.
* Behind the facades of residential homes in the Borough of Queens, New York City, sometimes lie cramped "human beehives" for new immigrants who often live in illegal conditions.
